today.title: {weekday}, {month} {day}
today.never: No upload has arrived yet. Create a key and run the script on your PC.

keys.title: Keys
keys.intro: A key lets your PC's script upload the day's summary and lets Claude read it. It is shown only once.
keys.install: On Windows, install ActivityWatch + TimeLog and paste the key in its icon, next to the clock: «TimeLog: paste key…». It uploads by itself every hour.
keys.name: Key name
keys.nameInvalid: Give it a name of up to 60 characters.
keys.signedOut: Your session expired. Sign in again.
keys.revokeFailed: The key could not be revoked. Reload and try again.
keys.shown: Copy it now: it is not shown again.
keys.command: Without the installer, on the PC with ActivityWatch open:
keys.confirmRevoke: Revoke «{name}»? It stops uploading and reading.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: TimeLog keeps a summary of how long your computer spends in each app, day by day. We email you a link to sign in.
signIn.sent: Check your email: the link brings you back here.
signIn.emailInvalid: That email does not look right.
signIn.notInvited: That email is not invited to TimeLog.
signIn.sendFailed: The link could not be sent. Try again.
signIn.rateLimited: You have asked for several links. Wait a few minutes.
signIn.linkInvalid: The link did not work or has expired. Ask for another.

notFound.title: That page does not exist
notFound.text: The day you are looking for does not exist or has not arrived yet.
